text:
Maya Chen: Quick async standup — short notes on SDK quickstarts & sample apps. What I did: updated Node + Python quickstarts to use new init flow, added a tiny mac-arm smoke job to sampleapp CI, fixed one broken config example in docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612 (small rewrite + tests). Blockers: Windows sampleapp CI keeps failing due to path separators (see logs), and I need a quick review on the docs PR so we can merge before tomorrow's release. Question: should quickstarts pin an exact SDK version or use ^ to float minor patches? Today: finish docs PR, pair with @Liam on Windows CI, add a changelog entry.

Liam O'Connor: I'll take the Windows CI issue. suspect it's the shell script using `/` in a few places. quick fix: replace hardcoded paths with path.join in the Node sample. e.g.

  const configPath = path.join(__dirname, 'config', 'dev.json')

That should make `npm run smoke` pass on Windows and mac. I'll open a quick PR to the sampleapp.

Samir Patel: I can review #612 today. note: the new init flow changes CLI flags a bit — add a tiny unit test in sampleapp/tests/init.test.js that asserts the generated config contains `defaultModel`. I can review faster if the test is included.

Nisha Rao: on pinning: prefer `^0.9.0` in quickstarts (allows patch/minor that keep semver promise) and add a compatibility note in the README: "If you need stable behavior across deploys, pin to an exact patch". That keeps quickstarts friendly but gives ops a clear option.

Maya Chen: @Samir adding the test now, thanks. @Liam if you put up the Windows PR link here I will run the mac-arm smoke job after merge. I'll also add the compatibility note per @Nisha and keep the examples using `^0.9.0`.

Liam O'Connor: PR for Windows fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/198 — switched to path.join + adjusted CI shell quoting. also added `npm ci` before smoke to avoid caching issues. :crossed_fingers:

devex-ci-bot: CI status for PR #198: windows-smoke FAILED (path error), mac-smoke PASSED, linux-smoke PASSED — failing step: `node ./scripts/run-smoke.js` returned exit code 1. Full log: https://ci.internal/redwood/198/logs

Maya Chen: ack, I'll look at the failing script line later today and try a quick repro on a Windows VM. If I can't reproduce by EOD I'll escalate to infra.

Samir Patel: reviewed #612 — left small wording nits on the quickstart text, otherwise LGTM. added request: please include the test before merging. :white_check_mark:

Maya Chen: thanks all — action items: 1) me: add Windows repro/patch or escalate, 2) Samir: quick review after test, 3) Liam: follow up on CI retry, 4) Nisha: I'll add compatibility blurb to README. Will post here when docs PR merges. :thumbsup:
